description: FR3 (FS1 F5, design Task 32): the per-project protected protocol file <project>/benchmarks/project/protocol/protocol.json. It carries the project's own protected data: its models, oracle file, tolerances, solver constants, planning shares, decision policies, required before_run checks, test stubs, panel models, library report and local aggregate schema. The framework names none of these values. bench.json binds the file by sha256 (bench_model.project_bench refuses an unbound or edited file); the file binds each referenced file by sha256; bench run records the digest in run.json (protocol_sha256) and decide refuses a run whose recorded digest differs from the current file. A change needs the approver (safety/protected-paths.json project_protected).

cases.description: The case ids of the project that this protocol covers; each must be a case of bench.json.

approval.description: The approver state of this protocol. A decision policy of the protocol is filled only when the state is APPROVED.

models.description: The model (selector) names of the project. The panel models, planning shares, stub selectors and library report selectors are names of this list.

tolerances.description: The project's agreement tolerances. A value that is an object with a `state` is the tolerance block of the selector of the same name: a plan or a run of that selector is refused until the state starts with `locked` (bench_model.require_locked_selectors).

solver.description: The project's numeric solver constants; the framework reads none of them.

budgets.description: The project's planning shares per selector (Amendment I3 R14, I10.1): a selector that share_required lists needs an estimate_share_per_selector value.

before_run_required.description: T29-APP-01 (P15 removed-safety-check): per case id of this project, the project checks that must stay declared in bench.json with before_run true; bench validate and bench run refuse the case (FAIL) when one is missing or switched off.

decision_policies.description: The project's unit-threshold decision policies (Amendment G9.1 with I8.1 and I15.6). bench decide --policy NAME loads one by name from the protocol of the run's project. The statistical constants are pinned because tools/bench_units.py and benchlab/coverage.py decide with them.

stubs.description: Test-only call-deadline stubs (Amendment G2.3, G2.6, I9.4): bench selftest runs one stub run and one stub check per entry. The case must declare a call deadline with the reason and the variant; the check must be a check of bench.json. The coordinator passes SAFE_C_TEST_STUB=<reason> to the trial child of the stub plan only.

panel.description: The single-record panel reference of the project (Amendment G3.3, I7.2, H21): the models of the panel inputs (mask = 2^n - 1 in this order) and the digest form of its reference.

verdict_counts.description: FR5 (ruling FR5-R1 item 2): the names of the project's own verdict counts. A trial child reports them under verdict.verdict_counts (schemas/bench-observation.json); bench run refuses an observation that names another count.

library_report.description: Amendment G2.3: the unit records of these selectors carry the library label, the library overhead per row and the reference admit exclusions of the run.

local_exceptions.description: Exception class names of the project that a local aggregate may count by name; every other class counts as Other.

oracle.description: The project's oracle data file in the protocol directory, bound by sha256.

aggregate_schema.description: The JSON schema of the `summary` block of a local aggregate of this project (schemas/bench-local-aggregate.json), bound by sha256.

cell_rule.description: FR5 (ruling FR5-R1 item 1): the panel cell rule of the project (tools/bench_panel.py): a generic banded rule over the project's named row columns. The panel inputs carry one column per name. A cell takes the candidate rows of its category value whose position lies in its band; the fallback level comes from |log(scale / scale_target)| against log(level_ratios[0]) and log(level_ratios[1]); grid holds the grid test settings; the distance is |position - position_target| + |log(scale / scale_target)|. The report entries are the values that the panel rows and the decision record show (value = column x factor). bench_model checks the cross-field rules (distinct role columns, reserved names, known category labels, increasing ratios).

grid.description: FR5A-01 (ruling FR5-R3): the settings of the project's grid test (the per-row grid_ok of the panel inputs): a finite upper bound above 0 and an integer point count of 2 to 4096 (the framework limit, tools/bench_panel.GRID_POINTS_MAX). The framework names no value; the panel inputs and the reference carry these settings.

state.description: FR3-02 (A6P-05, N6): provisional-<name> or locked-<name>; the bare state locked is refused.
